integrity: The arbitrary-order claim is proved analytically from part sizes and degree order. Exhaustive computation through order 8 is used only as a finite stress test and not as evidence for the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the non-strict strong-domination degree convention from the initiating paper, excludes complete graphs, and does not address strict-degree variants. Literature coverage is limited by indexing and by the possibility of later revisions to the 2026 preprint.
title: Strong-domination stability of complete multipartite graphs
